neighbours.label: a cooking heat level ('over medium-high heat', 'on high')
fire: Melt the butter in a pan over medium-high heat until it foams.
Sear the steaks on high heat for two minutes per side.
Simmer the sauce over low heat, stirring now and then.
Warm the milk gently over medium heat without letting it boil.
Stir-fry the vegetables in a wok over very high heat.
Toast the seeds in a dry skillet over medium-low heat.
Fry the onions over medium heat until they turn golden.
Reduce the stock over high heat until half remains.
quiet: Melt the butter in a pan and add the chopped garlic.
Sear the steaks quickly and rest them before slicing.
Simmer the sauce for twenty minutes, stirring now and then.
Warm the milk gently in a small pan without letting it boil.
Stir-fry the vegetables in a wok with soy sauce and ginger.
Toast the seeds in a dry skillet until they smell nutty.
Fry the onions with a pinch of salt until they turn golden.
Reduce the stock until half remains, then strain it.

notes: Top examples are scattered (solitaire Foundations, 'there is only one boat', poker variants, coughing, Vesuvius, 'medium-high' heat). Probe: 'medium-high heat' 0.65, 'high heat' 0.38, foundations 0.72. Picked the most reproducible cue; likely partial at best.
